display.purpose: Hero headline and page h1s only.

body.purpose: Article prose via Tailwind Typography prose-zinc.

shadows.name: floating-chrome
shadows.purpose: Avatar badge, pill nav, mobile nav dropdown, and the fixed Currently Reading widget — the only elements that overlay scrolling content rather than sitting in the document flow.

components.name: Pill Nav
components.description: Floating desktop navigation pill with translucent, blurred background.
components.css: .ds-pill-nav ul { display: flex; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); padding-inline: 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #27272a; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(24,24,27,0.05); border: 1px solid rgba(24,24,27,0.05); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); } .ds-pill-nav a { display: block; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-pill-nav a:hover { color: #14b8a6; }

components.name: Post Preview Card
components.description: Post preview / content card with hairline border, no shadow (flat surfaces never carry shadows).
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 16px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-card h2 { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; color: #27272a; } .ds-card p { color: #52525b; }

components.name: Currently Reading Widget
components.description: Dismissible fixed corner widget; the one card-shaped surface that legitimately earns a shadow because it floats above scrolling content.
components.html:
Currently Reading
Book title
components.css: .ds-reading-widget { position: fixed; bottom: 1rem; right: 1rem; width: 18rem; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(24,24,27,0.05); padding: 1rem; } .ds-reading-widget__header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #71717a; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; } .ds-reading-widget__header button { color: #a1a1aa; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-reading-widget__header button:hover { color: #52525b; } .ds-reading-widget__book { display: flex; gap: 1rem; align-items: flex-start; } .ds-reading-widget__book img { width: 3rem; border-radius: 4px; aspect-ratio: 2/3; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Restrained primary action button, teal accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 500; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; background: #14b8a6; color: #ffffff; border: none; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0d9488; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(20,184,166,0.5); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Default quiet action, no border or fill until hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 500; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; background: transparent; color: #27272a; border: none; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f4f4f5; }

components.name: Tag List
components.description: Inline comma-separated tag links, not chip-styled.
components.css: .ds-tags { display: flex; gap: 0.25rem; align-items: center; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-tags a { color: #14b8a6; text-decoration: underline; } .ds-tags a:hover { color: #0d9488; }

narrative.overview:
The site is a fixed, dependable frame around content that changes: a small circular avatar that shrinks into a floating pill nav as you scroll, a stable two-column-width reading measure, and a footer that never competes for attention. Everything is neutral zinc gray at rest; a single teal accent marks the handful of things that are interactive (links, hover states, one primary action). The mood is quiet and restrained, closer to a working engineer's notebook than a "designed portfolio." Nothing decorative is allowed to compete with the words on the page.

The shadcn/starwind component kit that powers /consult and its Button/Card primitives originally shipped its own scaffolding colors (--primary: blue-700, --secondary: fuchsia-700) and a separate neutral-* gray family alongside the blog's hand-authored zinc-* utilities. Both have been consolidated: --primary/--primary-accent now resolve to teal-700 (light) / teal-700-teal-600 (dark), --secondary resolves to a neutral zinc-700/zinc-300 fill rather than fuchsia, and every --color-neutral-* token reference in global.css was repointed to the matching --color-zinc-* step. Semantic status tokens (info/success/warning/error) are unchanged; they signal state, not brand.
keyCharacteristics: One accent color (teal), used sparingly, everywhere else neutral zinc
Depth reserved for floating chrome (avatar, pill nav, mobile dropdown, Currently Reading widget); everything else is flat with hairline borders
Generous, centered reading column; no dense grid layouts
Sans-only type (Inter), no serif or display face
Rounded, soft geometry throughout (pill nav, rounded cards/images); no sharp corners

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only color that signals "interactive." It appears on ≤5% of any given screen: link hovers, icon-hover states, and the primary button. It never appears as a background fill or large surface.

rules.name: The One Gray Family Rule
rules.body: zinc is the project's only neutral scale. global.css's shadcn/starwind token layer (--background, --card, --muted, --border, etc.) resolves entirely to --color-zinc-* steps, matching the hand-authored zinc-* utilities used across the blog. Don't introduce gray-* or neutral-* utilities anywhere in the codebase.

rules.name: The Prose-First Rule
rules.body: Any block of running text (bio, article body, tag lists) goes through Tailwind Typography's prose prose-zinc dark:prose-invert rather than hand-set type scale utilities, so long-form content always inherits the same measure, leading, and link styling.

rules.name: The Floating-Chrome-Only Rule
rules.body: Shadows exist to signal "this sits above the page," not "this is a card." If an element doesn't scroll independently of the content beneath it (i.e. it isn't fixed/sticky and overlaid), prefer a hairline border/ring over a shadow.

dos: Do keep teal as the only accent color; every other surface stays zinc neutral.
Do reserve shadow-lg for elements that float above scrolling content (avatar, pill nav, mobile nav dropdown, Currently Reading widget); use a hairline border/ring everywhere else, even on cards.
Do route all long-form text through prose prose-zinc dark:prose-invert rather than hand-building a type scale.
Do keep the centered max-w-2xl/lg:max-w-5xl reading column consistent across header, content, and footer.
donts: Don't reintroduce blue-700/fuchsia-700 (the original starwind defaults) as a second accent; --primary/--secondary are consolidated to teal/zinc and should stay that way.
Don't use gray-* or neutral-* color utilities; zinc is the project's one neutral scale.
Don't add a serif or second display typeface; Inter carries every role.
Don't build a multi-column grid layout for content; the site's rhythm is a single stacked column at every breakpoint observed so far.
Don't add decorative shadows to flat surfaces (body text blocks, plain sections); depth is reserved for the floating header chrome.

Don't use a thick colored border-l-4-style accent bar for callouts/quotes; use a hairline border + soft neutral fill (rounded-lg, border-zinc-200/700, bg-zinc-50/zinc-800/50), matching the card language.
